author: host
status: canonical and fresh native domains supported by explicitly scoped competing hypotheses
original_rule_assessment: No established uniform original mechanism. Opus explicitly calls the exceptional rule fitted/uncertain. Atlas reproduces canonical labels with an additional visible condition, but supplies no independent evidence for that condition. It disagrees substantially with unchanged fresh native outputs. We cannot conclude that changing canonical labels is correct merely because it matches native generation.
factory_mechanism: Visible marker/axis parsing; demonstration-selected plain or repeated-nonmarker baseline; enumerate every repeated baseline and require identical complete outputs.
independent_gate: independent_gate.py require_evidence validates all demo inputs and query inputs; query output fields ignored
canonical_proposal: Earlier label-change proposal is superseded; no label change required or applied.
context_policy: Preserve each drawn query; resample demonstrations only until all surviving mechanism/geometry hypotheses agree on all supplied inputs. Query answers never select candidates.
limitations: Finite hypothesis scope only; not proof of uniquely intended benchmark semantics. The Atlas mechanisms are competing hypotheses selected by demonstration evidence, not asserted ground truth.
